home.about: Four tables, an open kitchen and dough stretched by hand, so every pizza is made right in front of you.

about.heroAlt: The two founders of Pizza Piatto in front of the shop
paragraphs: Pizza Piatto opened in 2022 as a tiny Italian-style pizza shop with just four tables, tucked inside Cư Xá Lý Thường Kiệt, opposite the Thống Nhất Sports Centre.
The kitchen is open, so you can watch every pizza being stretched, topped and baked. We blend two flours, give the dough time to rest and keep the menu short, so each pizza gets our full attention.

reservationPage.title: Save One of Our Four Tables
reservationPage.intro: The shop is small, so booking ahead is the surest way to find a table waiting and a pizza fresh from the open kitchen.

menu.title: Menu
menu.description: Twelve 30 cm pizzas, four kinds of spaghetti and a burrata salad, with plenty of choice for vegetarians.

hours.title: Hours
hours.description: We open in the evening on weekdays and from late morning on Saturdays. On Sundays the oven rests.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Call or message us to book, order or ask about our pizza classes. You will find us opposite the Thống Nhất Sports Centre.

cta.heading: Grab one of our four tables and watch your pizza come together in the open kitchen, or take it home still warm.
address: Diên Hồng, Ho Chi Minh City

heading: Made
By
Hand
imageBanner.description: At Pizza Piatto every pizza starts as a ball of rested dough and is stretched, topped and baked by hand, a few steps from your table.

dough.title: The Dough
dough.description: We blend two flours with the same protein but a different strength, then give the dough time to rest so it bakes up light, airy and full of flavour.

beginning.title: The Beginning
beginning.description: Pizza Piatto opened in 2022 as a small shop with four tables. It is still small, and it still means the world to us.

kitchen.title: The Open Kitchen
kitchen.description: Nothing stands between your table and the counter. Watch the dough being stretched and topped, and catch the smell of the crust as it leaves the oven.

toppings.title: The Toppings
toppings.description: Fresh mozzarella, burrata and Grana Padano sit alongside local favourites like our Italian-style roast pork, with plenty of vegetarian choices too.

classes.title: The Classes
classes.description: We also teach. Our pizza classes share what we have learned about dough, stretching and baking, from classic to contemporary Neapolitan.

takeaway.title: Dine In or Take Away
takeaway.description: Eat at one of our four tables, take your pizza home in a box or have it delivered warm. However you eat it, it is made the same way.

reviews.tranVanTrang: Delicious pizza with a true Italian taste and plenty of choice. I recommend the Fungus: rich, fragrant and unlike anything else. Thin, crispy crust.
reviews.tranQuynhDac: Ridiculously good!!! Thin base, a crisp and airy crust and nothing but quality toppings. Lots of vegetarian options for the no-meat crowd, too.
reviews.violetParisi: Nice Italian pizza, thin & crispy. Great taste. Kind owners.
reviews.minhThu: The owner is lovely, the pizza is unbelievably good and the shop is easy to find.
reviews.linhChi: The pizza and salad here are just to my taste. The space is quite small, so I usually take mine away.
reviews.senChanDoi: I came with my mum, who says Western food gets heavy fast, but she loved the salad here. As for me, the seafood pizza was amazing.
reviews.nguyenNghia: The Fungus pizza is out of this world. The shop is tiny though, so I mostly take away.
